items.title: Alvin "Red" Tyler Interview, 1996-06-19
items.q: Mack Rabinack, when we were touring... you're our band leader from day one.

ctx.x: Oh, the N crowd knew to call me Red.

But now, the, the, the thing is it reverted, reversed itself. Mack Rabinack, when we were touring, he never called me Red. He might put Alvin Red Tyler, but he said, you know, you're our band leader from day one. Did all the hits that came out of New Orleans. Alvin. Yeah.
But years ago when he was, he was coming up, didn't he know you, he didn't know you was Red?
